preconditions.description: Attacker must be authorized (owner or authorized address) to call setMultipliers function
Contract must have tradingOpen = true (trading enabled)

exploit_hint: Call setMultipliers function with _buy, _sell, or _trans set to 0. This will cause update_fees() to execute totalFee.mul(multiplier).div(100) where multiplier is 0, potentially bypassing tax limits. Then trigger a transfer to exploit the zero fee calculation in takeFee function where totalFee * multiplier = 0, resulting in no fees being charged.
